acceptanceCriteria: median step wall time on the PR #934 pair and two other recorded pairs drops measurably (numbers and loads retained) with no guarded result lost
body: Residual from the V1-1266 lane (PR #944, head 5f98009ae, TCQ-V0-062 corvint cem verify --guarding-tests). On the PR #934 change (base 85ba6321a, target 95622955d) the step spent the full 1200 s: internal/tasks/store had 394 candidates and internal/tasks/cli 362; 42 hunks searched gave 1 guarded, 7 unguarded, 12 revert-breaks-build, 9 no-candidate, 2 timeout, 11 total-limit (load 18.6-55.6). Expected: candidate narrowing keeps typical changes under the budget. Reproduce: corvint cem verify --guarding-tests on that pair.
title: cem verify --guarding-tests spends its full 1200 s budget on large packages (K5 latency)
